component.name: GnomeEngine
component.summary: Import and preview local video backgrounds

description.p: GnomeEngine is an experimental native GNOME application for importing, organizing, and previewing local video backgrounds. It can control the separate GStreamer renderer service over the user's session bus.
An experimental GNOME Shell extension integrates the renderer surface as a desktop window. GNOME 50+ Wayland runtime validation is still pending.
First experimental native application and local library build.
